The '''Committee of Presidents of Statistical Societies''' ('''COPSS''') comprises the presidents, past presidents and presidents[[-elect]] of the following, primarily [[Northern America]]n, [[professional societies]] of [[statistician]]s:<ref name=members>{{cite web|title=COPSS Charter Members|url=http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/members2014.pdf|publisher=Council of Presidents of Statistical Societies|date=July 2014|access-date=2014-10-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150701093938/http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/members2014.pdf|archive-date=2015-07-01|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* [[American Statistical Association]]
* [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]
* Eastern North American Region of the [[International Biometric Society]]
* Western North American Region of the International Biometric Society
* [[Statistical Society of Canada]]

It also includes the president-elect-elect of Institute of Mathematical Statistics and the past-past-president of the Statistical Society of Canada.<ref name=members/>

COPSS is responsible for granting the following awards:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/committees.htm|title=COPSS Committees/Awards|publisher=COPSS|accessdate=21 October 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150221091235/http://nisla05.niss.org/copss/committees.htm|archive-date=21 February 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* The [[COPSS Presidents' Award]] for "an outstanding contribution to the profession of statistics" by a member of one of the constituent societies aged under 41
* The [[COPSS Distinguished Achievement Award and Lectureship]] for "achievement and scholarship in statistical science" that has made a "highly significant impact ... on scientific investigations"
* The [[Snedecor Award]] for "a noteworthy publication in [[biometry]] within three years of the data of the award"
* The [[Elizabeth L. Scott Award]] for "fostering opportunities in statistics for women"
* The [[Florence Nightingale David Award]] recognizes "a female statistician who serves as a role model to other women"
